scope: Only labels change. Same camera VecSetX features/visuals/initialization/update budget as camera dropout. Four fitted identities; no new-object or production-frame commitment. GT transforms only label construction and diagnostic scoring.

original_loss_replay_check.policy: Numerical BF16 replay within 0.1%; source, initialization and recorded input hashes remain exact. A small discrepancy does not establish its specific numerical cause.

target_quality_policy.explanation: One-voxel inter-grid agreement rejected 11 correct pre-training labels. The independently computed voxelization bound is below two original voxels. Keep one-voxel results descriptive and use identical two-voxel common-unit scoring for all compared arms.
